description: -webkit-line-clamp as Chromium 153 lays it out (Tailwind 4's line-clamp-N: overflow hidden, display -webkit-box, vertical orientation): text clamped after 1, 2 and 3 lines with an ellipsis, in a card with padding and a border, text shorter than its clamp (not clamped), and a clamp through nested blocks (a title, the text, a block after the clamp); a text change to a short text and back moves or lifts the clamps, and a narrower width clamps at other points
